meta.title: Projects
meta.description: The MetaWorkFlow home page: list the Host's registered workflow projects, create one, import a Mermaid flowchart as a new project, or open, rename, and delete a project. Opening a project shows its workbench: the definition drawn as a flowchart with its run history, the node inspector with tool switches and execution records, the run controls, and the decisions its coordinator owes with that Session rendered in place.
